clips.title: The story
paras: Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun Starbreeze Village, east of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. Once a quiet night elf hamlet, it now lies in ruins beneath the spreading corruption of the World Tree.

Starbreeze Village lies southeast of Shadowglen, just down the road from Dolanaar. Peaceful night elf families once lived beneath Teldrassil’s boughs, but the village now lies in shambles. Aggressive Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun its wooden homes. Driven wild by corruption afflicting the World Tree’s boughs, they drove out the elven residents and fiercely defend the ruined grounds.
